v.en: O God, come to my assistance;

r.la: Et os meum annuntiábit laudem tuam.
r.en: And my mouth shall declare thy praise.

full.en: God is the great Lord * Come, let us adore Him.

la: Veníte, exsultémus Dómino, iubilémus Deo, salutári nostro: præoccupémus fáciem eius in confessióne, et in psalmis iubilémus ei.
Quóniam Deus magnus Dóminus, et Rex magnus super omnes deos, quóniam non repéllet Dóminus plebem suam: quia in manu eius sunt omnes fines terræ, et altitúdines móntium ipse cónspicit.

Quóniam ipsíus est mare, et ipse fecit illud, et áridam fundavérunt manus eius veníte, adorémus, et procidámus ante Deum: plorémus coram Dómino, qui fecit nos, quia ipse est Dóminus, Deus noster; nos autem pópulus eius, et oves páscuæ eius.
Hódie, si vocem eius audiéritis, nolíte obduráre corda vestra, sicut in exacerbatióne secúndum diem tentatiónis in desérto: ubi tentavérunt me patres vestri, probavérunt et vidérunt ópera mea.
Quadragínta annis próximus fui generatióni huic, et dixi: Semper hi errant corde, ipsi vero non cognovérunt vias meas: quibus iurávi in ira mea: Si introíbunt in réquiem meam.
en: Come let us praise the Lord with joy: let us joyfully sing to God our saviour. Let us come before his presence with thanksgiving; and make a joyful noise to him with psalms.
For the Lord is a great God, and a great King above all gods. For the Lord will not cast off his people: for in his hand are all the ends of the earth, and the heights of the mountains are his.

For the sea is his, and he made it: and his hands formed the dry land. Come let us adore and fall down: and weep before the Lord that made us: For he is the Lord our God: and we are the people of his pasture and the sheep of his hand.

Today if you shall hear his voice, harden not your hearts: As in the provocation, according to the day of temptation in the wilderness: where your fathers tempted me, they proved me, and saw my works.
Forty years long was I offended with that generation, and I said: These always err in heart. And these men have not known my ways: so I swore in my wrath that they shall not enter into my rest.

v.la: Audítui meo dabis gáudium et lætítiam.
v.en: To my hearing thou shalt give joy and gladness.

r.en: And the bones that have been humbled shall rejoice.

text.en: Our God * is our helper in troubles.

text.la: Magnus Dóminus * et laudábilis nimis in civitáte Dei nostri. ‡
text.en: Great is the Lord * and exceedingly to be praised in the city of our God. ‡

text.la: Os meum loquétur * sapiéntiam: et meditátio cordis mei prudéntiam.
text.en: My mouth shall speak * wisdom: and the meditation of my heart understanding.

text.la: Ne timúeris * cum dívite non descéndet in sepúlcrum glória eius.
text.en: Be not thou afraid * the things which made him rich, or his glory shall not descend with him to the sepulchre.
The God of gods, * the Lord hath spoken. ‡
Understand these things, * you that forget God.

text.la: Acceptábis sacrifícium * iustítiæ super altáre tuum, Dómine.
text.en: Thou shalt accept the sacrifice * of justice, upon thy altar, O Lord.

text.la: Pater Noster dicitur secreto usque ad Et ne nos indúcas in tentatiónem:
text.en: Our Father is said silently until And lead us not into temptation:.

text.la: A vínculis peccatórum nostrórum absólvat nos omnípotens et miséricors Dóminus.
text.en: May the Almighty and merciful Lord loose us from the bonds of our sins.

benedictio.la: Ille nos benedícat, qui sine fine vivit et regnat.
benedictio.en: May His blessing be upon us who doth live and reign for ever.

source.en: Lesson from the book of Ezekiel

text.la: 1 Et factus est sermo Dómini ad me, dicens: 2 Et tu, fili hóminis, hæc dicit Dóminus Deus terræ Israël: Finis venit, venit finis super quátuor plagas terræ. 3 Nunc finis super te, et immíttam furórem meum in te: et iudicábo te iuxta vias tuas, et ponam contra te omnes abominatiónes tuas. 4 Et non parcet óculus meus super te, et non miserébor; sed vias tuas ponam super te, et abominatiónes tuæ in médio tui erunt, et sciétis quia ego Dóminus.
text.en: 1 And the word of the Lord came to me, saying: 2 And thou son of man, thus saith the Lord God to the land of Israel: The end is come, the end is come upon the four quarters of the land. 3 Now is an end come upon thee, and I will send my wrath upon thee, and I will judge thee according to thy ways: and I will set all thy abominations against thee. 4 And my eye shall not spare thee, and I will shew thee no pity: but I will lay thy ways upon thee, and thy abominations shall be in the midst of thee: and you shall know that I am the Lord.

body.la: Indicábo tibi, homo, quid sit bonum aut quid Dóminus requírat a te:
body.en: I will show thee, O man, what is good, and what doth the Lord require of thee, but to

refrain.la: Fácere iudícium et iustítiam et sollícitum ambuláre cum Deo tuo.
refrain.en: Do justice and judgment, and to walk humbly with thy God.

verse.la: Spera in Dómino, et fac bonitátem, et inhábita terram.
verse.en: Trust in the Lord, and do good, and dwell in the land.

benedictio.en: God's most mighty strength alway be His people's staff and stay.

text.la: 5 Hæc dicit Dóminus Deus: Afflíctio una, afflíctio ecce venit. 6 Finis venit, venit finis, evigilávit advérsum te, ecce venit: 7 Venit contrítio super te, qui hábitas in terra; venit tempus, prope est dies occisiónis, et non glóriæ móntium. 8 Nunc de propínquo effúndam iram meam super te, et complébo furórem meum in te: et iudicábo te iuxta vias tuas, et impónam tibi ómnia scélera tua, 9 Et non parcet óculus meus, nec miserébor; sed vias tuas impónam tibi, et abominatiónes tuæ in médio tui erunt, et sciétis quia ego sum Dóminus percútiens.
text.en: 5 Thus saith the Lord God: One affliction, behold an affliction is come. 6 An end is come, the end is come, it hath awaked against thee: behold it is come. 7 Destruction is come upon thee that dwellest in the land: the time is come, the day of slaughter is near, and not of the joy of mountains. 8 Now very shortly I will pour out my wrath upon thee, and I will accomplish my anger in thee: and I will judge thee according to thy ways, and I will lay upon thee all thy crimes. 9 And my eye shall not spare, neither will I shew mercy: but I will lay thy ways upon thee, and thy abominations shall be in the midst of thee: and you shall know that I am the Lord that strike.

body.la: Angústiæ mihi sunt úndique, et quid éligam ignóro;
body.en: I am straitened on every side, and know not what to choose.

refrain.la: Mélius est mihi incídere in manus hóminum, quam derelínquere legem Dei mei.
refrain.en: It is better for me to fall into the hands of men, than to sin against the law of my God.

verse.la: Si enim hoc égero, mors mihi est; si autem non égero, non effúgiam manus vestras.
verse.en: For if I do this thing, it is death unto me and if I do it not, I cannot escape your hands.

benedictio.la: Ad societátem cívium supernórum perdúcat nos Rex Angelórum.
benedictio.en: May He that is the Angels' King to that high realm His people bring.

text.la: 10 Ecce dies, ecce venit; egréssa est contrítio, flóruit virga, germinávit supérbia, 11 Iníquitas surréxit in virga impietátis; non ex eis et non ex pópulo neque ex sónitu eórum, et non erit réquies in eis. 12 Venit tempus, appropinquávit dies: qui emit non lætétur, et qui vendit, non lúgeat: quia ira super omnem pópulum eius; 13 Quia qui vendit, ad id quod véndidit non revertétur: et adhuc in vivéntibus vita eórum.
text.en: 10 Behold the day, behold it is come: destruction is gone forth, the rod hath blossomed, pride hath budded. 11 Iniquity is risen up into a rod of impiety: nothing of them shall remain, nor of their people, nor of the noise of them: and there shall be no rest among them. 12 The time is come, the day is at hand: let not the buyer rejoice: nor the seller mourn: for wrath is upon all the people thereof. 13 For the seller shall not return to that which he hath sold, although their life be yet among the living. For the vision which regardeth all the multitude thereof, shall not go back: neither shall man be strengthened in the iniquity of his life.

body.la: Misit Dóminus Angelum suum et conclúsit ora leónum,
body.en: The Lord hath sent His angel, and hath shut the lions' mouths, that

refrain.la: Et non contaminavérunt, quia coram eo iniustítia invénta non est in me.
refrain.en: They have not hurt me forasmuch as before Him innocency was found in me.

verse.la: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
verse.en: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

text.la: Reliqua omittuntur, nisi Laudes separandæ sint.
text.en: Skip the rest, unless praying Lauds separately.

text.la: Deus, refúgium nostrum et virtus: adésto piis Ecclésiæ tuæ précibus, auctor ipse pietátis, et præsta; ut, quod fidéliter pétimus, efficáciter consequámur.
text.en: O God, our Refuge and Strength, Who art the author of all godliness, be ready, we beseech thee, to hear the devout prayers of thy Church, and grant that those things which we ask faithfully, we may obtain effectually.
